title: Lior and the Regiment
author: Wren Hartwell
blurb: Mara Hartwell, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent twenty years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
